stats.topPercentLowerTitle: Probability of reaching the same goal for fewer than this
stats.topPercentHigherTitle: Probability of getting more than this under the same conditions
stats.threeStarDescription: Only normal recruitment results are counted; half-pity/pity calls and recruitment point exchanges are excluded.
stats.goalTicketsDescription: Only recruitments where the goal was met are counted. If a recruitment has 'Pulls to goal' set, pulls only up to that point count (extra pulls made afterwards, e.g. toward a deliberate pity, are excluded).
stats.halfPityDescription: Calculated assuming a 50% pickup chance at each half-pity.
